headline: Jensen Huang reportedly hired a PR firm known for sex scandals last year
summary: Wired and TechCrunch reported that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang began working with a PR firm experienced in handling sex scandals as early as October 2025, around the time a New York Times report first described his business dealings with Alice Huang.

claims.statement: Huang engaged a PR firm known for handling sex scandals starting around October 2025.

sources.quote: Jensen Huang Hired a PR Firm Known for Handling Sex Scandals Last Year
The Nvidia CEO began working with consultants from Heller as early as October 2025, around the same time he was first linked to a suspected Chinese spy.
The PR firm was enlisted shortly after an October 2025 New York Times report described Alice Huang's business dealings with Jensen Huang, Wired reported.
